# Research execution contract
This is a paper-derived independent implementation, NOT the authors' ARSENY code.
Preserve source statements separately from derivations, numerical evidence and conjectures.
Audit -> derivation -> explicit approximations -> tests -> pilot -> bounded claim.
Never certify a branch from duplicate-root equality alone. Never integrate the identity probability tail as an elastic cross section.
Keep exponent policies and upper-shell sink semantics explicit. No physical production claim from stochasticity or same-code replay.
Sandbox first; heavy-only local handoff after measured pilot. Cache content identities, not arbitrary rounded keys. Atomic write+fsync, preserve failure records.
Do not rerun unchanged scientific suites without an affected dependency; add tests for changed assumptions and imported data.
No public redistribution of attached source PDFs. Preserve bibliographic metadata and SHA256 instead.

## Chat-first authoring and bounded cloud execution (owner approved 2026-09-28)
Mathematical design, substantive code changes, affected tests and prepared delivery
belong to the ChatGPT research thread. Cloud Codex consumes the pinned revision:
inspect the changed scope, verify host/input compatibility, make only a minimal
reproducible environment or execution-boundary fix, then run the authorized node.
Do not restart literature/design work or reimplement a delivered feature by default.
If scientific assumptions, tolerances, certificate policy or a substantial redesign
must change, preserve evidence and return the problem to the research thread.
Independent scientific review remains separate from authoring and execution.
Reuse unchanged, dependency-matched evidence; do not rerun completed HE resume-004
or the consumed bass_cr exactly-once F1-R2 under a new handoff label.
Keep immutable execution identity separate from the moving publication branch.
Detailed current delivery: research/shared_c64/20260928/R2/CHAT_FIRST_EXECUTION_POLICY_KO.md

## Accuracy-preserving HPC development (owner requested 2026-10-01)
For subsequent BASS_HE numerical research, use the measured HPC workflow in
research/shared_c64/20261001/NCP64_NATIVE_MPI_20261001T0520Z/HPC_POLICY_KO.md.
Develop binary64 Fortran/OpenMP/SIMD hot kernels and explicit OpenMPI task
parallelism, keeping the pinned Python/reference lane and numerical parity gates.
Select kernels and rank/thread layouts by same-workload measurements; do not
assume a Fortran rewrite or 64 ranks is faster. Preserve physics, conventions,
discretization and tolerances. No fast-math, hidden mixed precision or implicit
backend fallback. Detect actual CPU topology and memory limits before execution.
This is a development policy, not physical production promotion. C1b remains
scoped to R=2; C2 needs its own exact grid/continuation/scientific contract.

## 저장소 간 조건부 연결

채널을 선택할 때만 해당 공급자 조건을 적용한다. 모든 공급자의 동시 완료를 요구하지 않는다.


- `HE-X1` → `REI-L0`: using angular-moment injection. Necessary PSD/moment-cone gate only; does not supply angular distribution or physical cross section


- `HE-ANG` → `REI-L3`: selecting anisotropic baryonic scattering transport. Source-qualified angular moments needed; event frequency is not l2 transport


- `HE-EXCHANGE` → `REI-L3`: selecting finite-mass baryonic pressure exchange. Momentum/energy and pair symmetry from supported physical model


- `HE-CLOSURE` → `REI-L4`: selecting nonzero baryonic anisotropic stress. Isotropic pi_b=0 minimal pilot does not require this extension
